findings.description: The quiet deadline and eight-second cap deliberately allow a target reading again after restoration to receive prior clipboard content. findings.suggestion: Name the late-read schedules in test evidence and retain the documented residual limitation; record incompatible native cases against AC-016 and do not present bounded tests as proof for arbitrary application timing.
